name: Flowist
description_en:
Flowist presents itself as a progress tracker for remote teams. Its public workflow centers on daily check-ins that show what is done, in progress or blocked, with images and team announcements. Multiple projects separate work contexts. This is a status-communication model; the public materials do not establish a full dependency scheduler, billing ledger or detailed issue lifecycle.

The JavaScript-rendered homepage, pricing, signup and legal pages were read in a browser after the web reader returned shells. A rendered signup screen establishes that the form is visible, not that registration, email delivery or a working team workspace has been verified. No account was created.
description_zh:
Flowist 将自身定位为远程团队进度跟踪工具，公开流程围绕每日签到，展示已完成、正在做及被阻塞的工作，配合图片和团队公告，用多个项目区分工作上下文。这属于状态沟通模型，公开资料未确立完整依赖排程、计费台账或详细问题生命周期。

网页阅读器只返回 JavaScript 外壳后，此次在浏览器读取了渲染后的首页、价格、注册及法律页。能看到注册表单，只能证明表单可见，不能证明注册、邮件送达或团队工作区实际可用。没有创建账户。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Write the blocker so another person can act
sections.title_zh: 把阻塞写到他人可以采取行动
sections.en:
For a hypothetical design review, a teammate can describe a finished draft, the review currently in progress and a missing approval that blocks release. Attach an appropriate image if visual context matters. A useful blocker identifies the decision, its owner and the next check-in; merely writing Blocked gives the team less to act on.

This is an editorial example based on Flowist’s done/doing/blocked status dashboard, not a submitted update. Agree on the team’s check-in cadence and what counts as finished before comparing updates. Neither posting frequency nor an image proves output quality or worker productivity.
sections.zh:
假设进行设计复核，成员可说明已完成草稿、正在进行的审阅，以及阻塞发布的缺失批准；需要视觉上下文时附上适当图片。有用的阻塞说明应写清决策、负责人和下次核对点；只写 Blocked，团队较难行动。

这是依据 Flowist 已完成／正在做／被阻塞仪表盘提出的编辑样例，没有提交更新。比较签到前应约定节奏及完成标准。发帖频率或图片均不证明产出质量或员工生产力。

sections.title_en: Separate team announcements from individual status
sections.title_zh: 区分团队公告与个人状态
sections.en:
The homepage distinguishes shared announcements from daily teammate updates and describes multiple projects. Use that distinction to keep a team decision or changed milestone visible without making everyone repeat it in their check-in. For a pilot, inspect whether someone joining later can find the decision and the status it changed.

The public text does not establish edit history, approval, notification guarantees, comment permissions, exports or deleted-update recovery. Ask for a demonstration of correcting a wrong update and removing an accidentally shared image. Those are evaluation needs, not observed defects. Do not place the only copy of a release decision here until retention and retrieval have been checked.
sections.zh:
首页区分共享公告与成员每日更新，并介绍多个项目。可以利用这一区别呈现团队决定或里程碑变化，避免每位成员在签到中重复。试点应检查后加入者能否找到决定及它改变的状态。

公开文字未确立编辑历史、审批、通知保证、评论权限、导出或被删更新恢复。应要求演示如何修正错误更新及移除误共享图片。这些是评估需求，不是已观察缺陷。确认保留及检索前，不宜把发布决定的唯一副本放在这里。

sections.title_en: The displayed charge is a capped team plan
sections.title_zh: 展示费用对应有限团队方案
sections.en:
With Monthly selected, Basic displays $5/month for one team and up to three members; Pro $15/month for up to five teams and twenty members; Business $35/month for up to ten teams and fifty members. The cards do not label those amounts as per-user rates. They advertise a fourteen-day trial, while Enterprise requests a tailored plan.

The yearly toggle says two months free, but its actual charge, currency code, taxes and checkout were not verified. Clarify whether member limits are account-wide, how guests count, and what happens above the cap before estimating an organization. A finite trial does not establish sustained free use. Slack appears as soon on the plan cards, so its inclusion is not proof that it is operational.
sections.zh:
选择 Monthly 时，Basic 展示每月 $5，限一个团队及最多三名成员；Pro 每月 $15，最多五个团队及二十名成员；Business 每月 $35，最多十个团队及五十名成员。卡片没有把金额标为每用户费率。各方案宣传十四天试用，Enterprise 则要求定制方案。

年付切换标记两个月免费，但实际收费、币种代码、税费和结账均未验证。估算组织费用前，应澄清成员限制是否全账户计算、访客如何计数及超限处理。有限试用不代表持续免费。方案卡片将 Slack 标为 soon，包含它的文字不证明集成可运行。

sections.title_en: Visible registration does not verify a working workspace
sections.title_zh: 可见注册不证明工作区已可用
sections.en:
The public signup flow asks for a full name, company name, email and password, then describes email confirmation before starting. It links a combined legal page. No form field was filled, no email was supplied and Register was not pressed. Availability beyond those public screens remains unknown.

A team pilot should verify invitation roles, one authorized update and one unauthorized read/edit, then inspect delivery and account removal. The homepage explicitly calls Slack integration coming soon; do not design a workflow that depends on Slack posting until the actual account demonstrates it. No other integration, API, mobile app or self-host deployment was established by the read material.
sections.zh:
公开注册流程要求全名、公司名、邮箱及密码，并说明开始前需确认邮件；它链接一个合并法律页。本次没有填写字段、提供邮箱或点击 Register，公开屏幕以外的可用性仍未知。

团队试点应验证邀请角色、一次授权更新及一次未授权读写，再检查送达和账户移除。首页明确称 Slack 集成即将推出，在真实账户演示前，不应让流程依赖 Slack 发帖。此次材料未确立其他集成、API、手机应用或自托管部署。

sections.title_en: Resolve the commercial-use wording before team adoption
sections.title_zh: 团队采用前厘清商业使用文字
sections.en:
The linked legal text licenses site materials for personal, non-commercial transitory viewing and restricts copying/modification. That generic site-material clause does not establish a complete commercial team-service entitlement despite the business-oriented plans. The privacy page gives an effective date in January2020 and a general necessary-for-service retention statement, without a precise duration in the read text.

Request the applicable current subscription terms, cancellation/refund rules, data-processing scope, export and recovery commitments. No open-source or self-hosting grant was found. Shortlist Flowist only when the daily-status/announcement model matches the need and those commercial/operational gaps can be resolved. A copyright footer’s age alone does not prove the service has closed.
sections.zh:
链接法律文字只许可个人、非商业的临时浏览网站材料，并限制复制／修改。尽管方案面向业务，这种通用网站材料条款仍不能确立完整商业团队服务权益。隐私页标记 2020 年一月生效，笼统称按提供服务所需保留，所读文字没有具体期限。

应索取适用的当前订阅条款、取消／退款规则、数据处理范围、导出及恢复承诺。未找到开源或自托管授权。只有每日状态／公告模型符合需求，且这些商业／运营缺口可解决时，才适合列入候选。版权页脚较旧本身不证明服务关闭。
